body:
I was 10 at the time, and going to the dentist for teeth work.I was told that they were gonna use nitrous oxide on me.I thought nothing of it. When we got there the doctor put the mask on me.I was slightly exited cause they said its pretty much a drug. When I was starting to feel it,I felt slightly light.Then everything started to seem cartoonish. Everything was colorful, REAAAAALLY bright and detailed,I could see the cracks in the doctors fucking face!I then heard this odd noise.It was like 'EEEEEEE EEEEEE EEE' but it sounded like a girl was going 'EEE EEEEE EEE' at the same damn time. I felt so 'animated' and alive.I  wasnt laughing but I was in that 'laughter' type of mood.I felt like laughing but couldnt cause the doctor was doing surgery on my teeth.When they finished my mother said 'Are you okay' I said 'Yeh' in a weak voice.It sounded like my mom was far away and said 'Are you okay?' like...really far away. I dont remember much after that,but it was like being a cartoon.
